svg.title: SGF controlled committing read sets
svg.desc: Two parallel experimental-design panels with equal dimensions. Same-frame-count comparison: sink3 plus latest recent3 plus current3 versus recent6 plus current3, both nine frames. Recent-versus-self-only comparison: recent6 plus current3 versus current3, nine versus three frames. Each panel preserves the original sink3, older-to-newer recent6, current3 order. Unselected historical entries remain stored, physical cache capacity is twelve, denoising is unchanged, and current K/V is computed from the clean block. The sets depict the full-cache steady state. No measured outcomes or confidence intervals are drawn.
